data.text:
TRAFFIC ADVISORY

 In view of the “Fish Prasadam Distribution” organized by Bathini Mrigasira Trust from evening hours of 07-06-2025 to evening hours of 09-06-2025 at Exhibition Grounds, Nampally the traffic will be diverted in the below mentioned routes.

Route/Junctions to be avoided from evening hours of 07-06-2025 to evening hours of 09-06-2025: 
https://t.co/iOOLEZYQF1 Bazar Mosque towards Gandhi Bhavan via MJ Market Junction
2.Putli Bowli towards Gandhi Bhavan via MJ Market Junction
3.Yousufian Company towards Gandhi Bhavan via MJ Market Junction
4.Alaska Junction towards Malakunta Junction

DIVERSION POINTS SURROUNDING TO EXHIBITION GROUND TO BE AVOIDED: 

1.Traffic (Heavy Vehicles) coming from SA Bazar Mosque, Putli Bowli will not be allowed towards Gandhi Bhavan and will be diverted at MJ Market Junction towards Nampally Station Road via GPO Junction.
2.Traffic (Heavy Vehicles) coming from Ravindra Bharathi, will not be allowed towards Chappel Road and will be diverted at AR Petrol Pump towards BJR Circle.
3.Traffic (Heavy Vehicles) coming from GPO, Abids will not be allowed towards Gandhi Bhavan and will be diverted at MJ Market Junction towards SA Bazar Mosque.
ADVISORY FOR PUBLIC ARRIVING FOR FISH PRASADAM
1.Visitors arriving in 4-wheelers from the Nampally side for Fish Prasadam must park their vehicles at Gruha Kalpa, Gagan Vihar, or Chandra Vihar and proceed on foot to Exhibition Ground Gate No. 2.
 
2.Visitors arriving by bus/van from M.J. Market must alight at Gandhi Bhavan Bus Stop. Those coming from Nampally should alight at Gruha Kalpa Bus Stop and proceed to Exhibition Ground Gate No. 2.  
Cont…2
::  2  ::

https://t.co/FFuaODp5lh car pass holders arriving from M.J. Market should proceed via Ajanta Gate, Gandhi Bhavan, take a left turn towards Gate No. 1 and CWC Gate (VIP Entry). Those coming from Nampally must take a U-turn at Gandhi Bhavan, then a left turn towards Gate No. 1 and CWC Gate. Parking will be in the designated VIP area.  

4.Two-wheeler riders arriving from M.J. Market must park at Manoranjan Complex. Those coming from Nampally should park on the left side of the road (designated for two-wheelers) between Gruha Kalpa and BJP Office.  

5.Auto-rickshaw drop-off points are designated near Shezan Hotel, Bhavani Wines/Juvenile Court, and Excise Office. Parking for autos is allocated on the left side of the road.  

6.General traffic from M.J. Bridge and Begum Bazar Chatri heading to Nampally will be diverted at Alaska towards Darusalam, Ek Minar, etc.  

All Commuters are requested to make note of the above diversions and take alternative routes to reach your destinations and to follow traffic updates on our social media platform@Hyderabad Traffic Police face book page (https://t.co/RMgFu4sqLB) and @HYDP (Twitter handle). In case of any emergency in travel, kindly call our traffic help line 9010203626 for travel assistance.

All citizens are requested to cooperate with the Hyderabad Traffic Police.

Jt. Commissioner of Police,
Traffic, Hyderabad City.

TRAFFIC ADVISORY

 In connection with EID-UL-AZHA (BAKRID) prayers at Mir Alam Tank Eidgah, Hyderabad and on 07-06-2025  from 7.00 AM to 11.30 AM, the following traffic diversions and parking arrangements will be made.  

MIR ALAM TANK EIDGAH:
The vehicular traffic coming from Puranapul, Kamatipura, Kishanbagh towards the Eidgah, Mir Alam Tank for prayers will be allowed through Bahadurpura X Roads from 7.00 AM to 11.30 AM and they should park vehicles at parking places mentioned below. During this period, the general vehicular traffic will not be allowed towards Eidgah, Tadban and it will be diverted towards Dr. Manmohan Singh express flyover (Zoo Park to Aramgarh).
Parking places provided at: 1) Parking area beside Zoo Park Wall, 2) Open space Opp: Masjid Allah-ho-Akbar.

The vehicular traffic coming from Shivarampally & Danamma Huts towards the Eidgah, Mir Alam Tank for prayers will be allowed through Dannama Huts X Roads from 7.00 AM to 11.30 AM and they should park vehicles at parking places mentioned below. During this period, the general vehicular traffic will not be allowed towards Eidgah and it will be diverted at Danamma Huts X Roads towards Shastripuram, NS Kunta, etc.
Parking places provided at: 1) Modern Petrol Pump in front of Eidgah main road, 2). Inside and Outside Mir Alam filter bed 3) single line parking from Sufi Cars to Modern Petrol Pump, (for four wheelers) and 4)Parking from Yadav Parking to Legacy Palace.              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
The vehicular traffic coming from Kalapather towards the Eidgah Mir Alam Tank for prayers will be allowed through Kalapather L&O PS from 7.00 AM to 11.30 AM and they should park vehicles at parking places mentioned below. During this period, the general vehicular traffic will not be allowed towards Eidgah and it will be diverted at Kalapather L&O PS towards Mochi Colony, Bahadurpura, Shamsheergunj and Nawab saheb Kunta. 
Parking places provided at 1). Mass Material shop Parking,                        2) Indian Oil Petrol bunk.

From 7.00 AM to 11.30 AM the heavy vehicles coming from Puranapul towards Bahadurpura will be diverted towards Ziyaguda and City College side (On need Basis) till the entire congregation disperses after prayers from the Eidgah.
From 7.00 AM to 11.30 AM the heavy vehicles coming from Shamshabad, Rajendra Nagar and Milardevpally towards Bahadurpura will be allowed from Dr. Manmohan Flyover till the entire congregation disperses after prayers from the Eidgah.
From 7.00 AM to 11.30 AM the heavy vehicles going from Bahadurpura side towards Shamshabad, Rajendra Nagar and Milardevpally will be allowed from Dr. Manmohan Flyover till the entire congregation disperses after prayers from the Eidgah.

All Commuters are requested to make note of the above diversions and take alternative routes to reach your destinations and to follow traffic updates on our social media platform@Hyderabad Traffic Police face book page (https://t.co/RMgFu4sqLB) and @HYDP (Twitter handle). In case of any emergency in travel, kindly call our traffic help line 9010203626 for travel assistance.

All citizens are requested to cooperate with the Hyderabad Traffic Police.

data.text:
🇺🇸 THE MORAL CRUSADE OF D-DAY: WHY PETE HEGSETH’S SPEECH MATTERS TO THE WORLD 🌍

🪖 81 Years Later, We Must Ask: Are We Still Worthy of Their Sacrifice?

At the Normandy American Cemetery, overlooking sacred ground consecrated with the blood of thousands, @SecDef @PeteHegseth  didn’t just give a speech—
He delivered a message of eternal consequence.

Not just for Americans. But for humanity.

He reminded us that freedom is never free—that behind every sandcastle built today on peaceful shores lies the shadow of those who stormed those same beaches under a hail of fire. 

Young men—farmhands, baseball players, store clerks—threw themselves into the jaws of death not for conquest, but for the conscience of the world.

💥 “Could you do what they did? Could I? Could we?” 
Hegseth asked.

That is the question. And it’s not rhetorical.

🌊 The Battlefield Became a Beach

In one of the most moving parts of his address, Hegseth spoke of running with Army Rangers at dawn on Omaha Beach—over sand now dotted with castles built by children, not craters made by mortars. That image alone says everything:

“What those men fought for—that we may turn scenes of death into scenes of life. Scenes of war into scenes of peace.”

This is not just an American story.
This is a moral heritage passed on to all free peoples.
And the price tag isn’t just in memory.

It’s in vigilance, responsibility, and readiness—because evil is not gone from the Earth.

🛡️ Freedom Must Be Defended, or It Will Be Taken

The power of this speech lies in the uncomfortable truth it delivers:

🕯️ “They fought—and we fight—knowing our kids and grandkids must be willing to do the same.”

We’ve told ourselves for decades that World War II was “the war to end all wars.”

But that’s a dangerous lie.
History isn’t over.
Tyranny adapts.
Evil rebrands.

And weakness invites it back.

📜 A New Generation Must Rise

Hegseth’s answer to the haunting question—“Do we still produce such men?”—wasn’t just hopeful; it was affirmative.

“Yes. We do. From far-flung places, willing to traverse the globe to defend freedom.”

And that’s the essence of moral civilization:
Passing down memory with meaning

Teaching our children not just what happened, but why it mattered

Living lives worthy of the sacrifices that gave us liberty

✝️ Before God and Among Heroes

“It is a sheer privilege to stand in this cemetery—among heroes, and before God.”

Let that sink in.
He placed God and the fallen side by side.
Not as political rhetoric, but as a sacred duty.

It’s the reminder that no law, no right, no peace exists without the moral order to uphold it.

🌍 What This Means to the World

To every nation watching:
If you value freedom, this is your story too.
D-Day wasn’t about expanding America’s borders.
It was about defending humanity’s soul.

From France to Poland, from Israel to Taiwan, from the Philippines to Ukraine—every free people owes a piece of their liberty to the courage of those men on June 6, 1944.

And every generation owes it to them to be worthy of that gift.

🗣️ Final Call: Are We Still Worthy?

We must teach it.
We must live it.
We must fight for it—not just in war, but in the war of ideas, values, and truth.

Because the beaches may be peaceful today—
But storms always return.

🌟 Live worthy of their sacrifice.
🗽 Stand for liberty.
🙏 Honor God.
🔥 Teach your children why it matters.
